$comment: Case 2's caller items, which open when Hugo's agent runs the check runner's tools (docs/fixture-money.md, Caller items on the preview seed): Hugo's agent explains each receiving feature's differing calls and classifies every one of them as intended with the reason under calls; that feature's agent reviews the explanation.

explanations.holiday-closures: start_of_day() now returns UTC midnight. is_closed() takes the store's day from it, so 20:00 on Christmas at UTC-08:00 reads as 26 December. The plan's fix in your fork calls start_of_local_day() with the store's offset, which keeps the store's whole local day closed.
explanations.weekly-digest: start_of_day() now returns UTC midnight. The digest's send time starts from it, so a shopper west of UTC gets the digest at another hour. The plan's fix in your fork starts the send time from start_of_local_day() with the shopper's offset.

holiday-closures.reason: start_of_day() now returns UTC midnight. A store west of UTC reads its day from the next date.

weekly-digest.reason: start_of_day() now returns UTC midnight. The send time moves for a shopper west of UTC.

reviews.holiday-closures: Approved. With start_of_local_day() a closure covers the store's whole local day.
reviews.weekly-digest: Approved. With start_of_local_day() the digest goes out at the shopper's local hour.
